name: Purchase Price (Speculative Trade)
description: p.63. Step 3) Determining the Purchase Price: Roll 2D. DMs: + the spacer’s Broker Skill rank (or the Broker Skill of any employed NPC broker); + the Purchase DM of the trade goods, based on the location on the Trade Goods table; - the selling NPC’s Broker Skill (professional sellers have Broker 2, meaning -2DM). Result is the percentage of the base price.

name: Sale Price (Speculative Trade)
description: p.63. Step 5) Determine Sale Price: Roll 2D + Broker rank, as in Step 3, using the Sale Price column. DMs: + Broker Skill rank (or employed NPC broker); + the Resale DM of the trade goods for the location. Negotiating: every step increase is +1DM and every step decrease is -1DM to the negotiation roll. Result is the percentage of the base price.

name: Trade Goods (Speculative Trade)
description: The Toolkit's trade calculator applies the illicit supplier DM to the tens die for you. To roll this table by hand, add 10 to the result for an illicit supplier. p.63-64. Roll D66. Illicit suppliers add +1DM to the D66 trade table (applied to the tens die, giving results 21-76). A location offers a number of different goods equal to its population code: results 11-16 (six goods) plus population - 6 goods that match its trade codes (example, p.63: population 9 Industrial = 11-16 plus 3 Industrial goods); each seller also has one more good rolled on D66. BOOK: the book does not cover worlds below population 6; they still offer 11-16. Trade codes: Ag Agricultural, As Asteroid, De Desert World, Ge Garden World, Ic Ice-Capped, In Industrial, Na Non-Agricultural, Ni Non-Industrial, Po Poor, Ri Rich, Ht High Tech, Va Vacuum, Wa Water World (p.65).
